test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Wet behind the ears

options.text: A sudden change in fortune due to a windfall
To be young and without experience

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e. **'To be young and without experience'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given idiom** 'Wet behind the ears'** (अनुभवहीन) refers to being young and without experience.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- *'To be young and without experience'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **To win a bet** (शर्त जीतना) - Not related to the given idiom.
 
• **A sudden change in fortune due to a windfall** (अचानक धन लाभ) - Not related to the given idiom.
 
• **To place a bad bet** (बुरी शर्त लगाना) - Not related to the given idiom.
